request.description: Original Pulp Wars chunky clean 2D strategy-game illustration, playful board-game sticker, strong dark colored outline, mostly flat colors, two-level cel shading, minimal texture, simple highlight, intentionally drawn rather than rendered, charming silly adventurous tone. Revision-11 WORKING HARBOR, southeast three-quarter view. A long broad stone-and-timber public quay spans the full back edge, with two thick separated pier arms projecting southeast around a LARGE open docking basin. One bold cargo group of large crates and barrels, thick mooring posts, coiled rope and a modest short hoist fills the back quay. Keep x80..304,y168..330 visibly open for resources and ships. Low and very wide substantial silhouette, still one tile. Exactly one connected blank coral warehouse panel covers 8-15 percent.
